## Fushi 3.3.0

- **Review (Fushi SRS)**: the built-in review system is now available in formal releases and is the default review method in onboarding. Includes the Fushi Card note type, a visual template editor, card browser, note-type editor and statistics; one-tap Anki (.apkg) and Lapis migration; Kaishi 1.5k starter deck; FSRS and RWKV scheduling; new cards ordered by word frequency; edit while reviewing, custom study, batch note edits, automatic backups with point-in-time restore, and reviewing on a paired device. The review home is redesigned with today's plan, a heatmap and a forecast
- **Reading**: Apple Books-style page curl for novels and manga; bookmarks, underline highlights and jump-back history; vertical two-page spreads on foldables; long-press images to save them; manga zoom controls, seamless long strips, AVIF pages and PDF text layers; manga OCR now defaults to on-device recognition instead of Google Lens; Kavita servers with two-way progress sync
- **Video**: primary and secondary subtitles can be revealed separately; Japanese subtitles with MOSS / Parakeet plus glossary and LLM proofreading; multi-source subtitle fusion, editable subtitle lines, and AI subtitles that inherit existing ASS styles; tap to show subtitles in immersive mode; manual watched marks and default subtitle languages; the phone remote adds on-demand playback, a touchpad mode, online subtitle search and web-video control; DVD menus; Jellyfin / Emby library scope, with media-server items in Continue
- **Music & audiobooks**: new Music module with sandboxed online plugin sources, lyrics provider plugins (LRCLIB built in) and Apple Music (sign-in, full tracks, library); Audiobookshelf streaming, progress sync and server subtitles; multi-voice read-along from the studio cast; lyrics mode exits the book with Esc, scrolls between lines more smoothly, keeps the bottom bar visible, jumps by progress and shows jump marks, and illustration cards stay up for the image-pause duration; selectable system TTS engines and voices on every platform, plus VOICEVOX / AivisSpeech / SHAREVOX / VOICEPEAK
- **Lookup & mining**: faster lookups, ranking by the source text's own ruby, and Chinese lookups fall back to traditional characters; choose and preview the word-audio source and the video sentence-audio source; undo or delete mined cards; background mining queue for the Fushi review target; Senren note type preset and the `{popup-selection-html}` placeholder; mining position goes into MiscInfo instead of a `chars_` tag; dictionaries grouped by language, with downloads continuing in the background on Android and iOS
- **Sync**: a new review sync with an operation log, conflict center, timeline restore, encryption, multiple storage locations and named devices; resumable, verified interconnect transfers; cloud backup can be turned on separately from interconnect; optional sync of portable settings
- **Profiles & interface**: per-work profiles now apply as a session overlay that also covers the Anki deck, review mining target, theme, video subtitle style and fonts, including in the lookup popup process; page backdrop presets and custom images per module; redesigned home, media details and library menus, collection management with drag reorder, an M3E side rail and more bottom-bar styles, and a library panorama; works and source libraries can be marked private to stay off the leaderboard
- **Browser & AI**: a full tabbed browser with history, bookmarks, downloads, find, incognito and the browser-extension stack, with web videos handed to the player and web comics / novels readable; the extension can look up words in canvas readers such as BookWalker; idle auto-mining from web video on Windows; an in-app AI assistant with undoable actions and multiple conversations, also reachable by external AI clients over MCP or `fushi_cli`; AI library organizing
- **Games**: galgame adapters for knife (Tsukihime), SoftPal and Siglus (Rewrite+ / Rewrite Harvest festa!); overlay line read-aloud; game streaming adds controller button profiles, a controller lookup mode and a lookup panel on a second display
- **Platforms**: Linux and Steam Deck support (GPU video on X11, LAN discovery without Avahi, Game Mode fixes) with Flatpak packaging; Android home-screen widgets; Apple widgets, Live Activities, controls and a macOS menu bar player; Windows WebView frames align with the compositor, up to 144 Hz; reader, lyrics, music, manga and game-streaming pages can drag the window on desktop
- **Fixes**: garbled EPUB text on Chinese Windows; WebView GPU memory growth on resize; Windows video stutter and long frames; Android SIGILL on some newer CPUs; Huawei HarmonyOS refusing to install the APK; audio recovery after an audio device fails, plus a macOS audio fallback; startup with corrupted desktop settings; Jellyfin requests and WebDAV paths with Japanese names; plus many reader, lyrics, subtitle, sync and mining fixes from in-app feedback

### Notes

- **AnkiConnect reordering**: AnkiConnect 26.10.11.0 and later refuse to write a card's due position. Fushi now reorders new cards by word frequency only through AnkiConnect's native `scheduling.repositionNewCards`. When that method is not detected, manual and automatic reordering are disabled with a hint. This includes current AnkiConnect releases that do not ship it yet and older AnkiConnect versions without `/api/v1`, so **users of classic AnkiConnect lose word-frequency reordering** until they update to a release that provides the native method. Reordering inside Fushi SRS is unaffected
- Holding cards while Anki is unreachable is now a switch and is off by default
- Removed: the video skip-intro button
- After a crash, Fushi asks on next launch whether to send the logs; auto-send is off by default
- Galgame hooking remains Windows-only; Linux only gets the external texthooker page
- iOS continues to exclude online extension sources, discovery and the general download center

## Fushi 3.3.0 更新公告

- **复习（Fushi 复习）**：内置复习在正式版开放，并成为新手引导默认的复习方式。包括 Fushi 卡片笔记类型、可视化模板编辑器、卡片浏览器、笔记类型编辑与统计；一键迁移 Anki（.apkg）与 Lapis；Kaishi 1.5k 入门牌组；FSRS 与 RWKV 排程；新卡按词频出卡；复习中编辑、自定义学习、批量改笔记、自动备份与按时间点恢复，以及在已配对设备的复习库上远程刷卡。复习首页重做，含今日计划、热力图与预测
- **阅读**：小说与漫画新增 Apple Books 式卷页翻页；书签、下划线高亮与回跳历史；折叠屏竖排双页；长按图片可保存；漫画缩放控件、无缝长条、AVIF 页面、PDF 文字层；漫画 OCR 默认改为设备端识别，不再走 Google Lens；支持 Kavita 服务器并双向同步进度
- **视频**：主副字幕可分开显示；MOSS / Parakeet 日语字幕，可配术语表与 LLM 校对；多来源字幕融合、可编辑字幕行，AI 字幕继承已有 ASS 样式；沉浸模式点画面显字幕；手动标记已看、默认字幕语言；手机遥控新增点播、触控板模式、在线搜字幕与网页视频控制；DVD 菜单；Jellyfin / Emby 库范围，媒体服务器条目进入「继续」
- **音乐与有声书**：新增音乐模块，支持沙箱化的在线插件来源、歌词源插件（内置 LRCLIB）与 Apple Music（登录、完整曲目、资料库）；Audiobookshelf 串流、进度同步与服务器字幕；按制作台角色多声音朗读；歌词模式 Esc 直接退书、换句滚动更顺、底栏常驻、可按进度跳转并显示跳转刻度，插图卡停留时长跟随「图片暂停」设置；系统语音五端可选引擎与声音，新增 VOICEVOX / AivisSpeech / SHAREVOX / VOICEPEAK
- **查词与制卡**：查词提速，按原文自带注音排序，中文查词简体查不到时回落繁体；可选择并试听单词音频来源与视频句子音频来源；可撤销或删除已制的卡；Fushi 复习目标的后台制卡队列；Senren 笔记类型预设与 `{popup-selection-html}` 占位符；制卡位置写入 MiscInfo，不再用 `chars_` 标签；词典按语言分组，Android 与 iOS 上下载可在后台继续
- **同步**：全新复习同步，含操作日志、冲突中心、时间线恢复、加密、多存储位置与设备命名；互联传输可续传并校验；云备份可与互联分开启用；可选同步可移植设置
- **配置与界面**：作品级配置改为会话覆盖层，并覆盖 Anki 牌组、复习制卡目标、主题、视频字幕样式与字体，查词弹窗进程同步生效；页面背景预设与按模块自定义背景图；首页、媒体详情与库菜单重设计，合集管理可拖动排序，M3E 侧栏与更多底栏样式，媒体库全景；作品与来源库可标为私密，不上排行榜
- **浏览器与 AI**：完整的多标签浏览器，含历史、书签、下载、页内查找、无痕与浏览器扩展能力，网页视频交给播放器，也能看网页漫画与小说；扩展可在 BookWalker 等 canvas 阅读器上取词；Windows 网页视频空闲自动制卡；应用内 AI 助手，操作可撤销、支持多会话，外部 AI 客户端可经 MCP 或 `fushi_cli` 调用；AI 整理库
- **游戏**：新增 knife（月姬）、SoftPal 与 Siglus（Rewrite+ / Rewrite Harvest festa!）适配；悬浮台词朗读；游戏串流支持手柄按键方案、手柄查词模式与副屏查词面板
- **平台**：支持 Linux 与 Steam Deck（X11 下 GPU 视频、无 Avahi 也能发现局域网设备、游戏模式修复），并提供 Flatpak 打包；Android 桌面小组件；Apple 小组件、实时活动、控制项与 macOS 菜单栏播放器；Windows WebView 取帧对齐合成器，最高跑满 144 Hz；桌面端阅读器、歌词、音乐、漫画与游戏串流页可拖动窗口
- **修复**：中文 Windows 上 EPUB 正文乱码；WebView 调整大小时显存增长；Windows 视频卡顿与长帧；部分新 CPU 上 Android 闪退（SIGILL）；华为 HarmonyOS 无法安装 APK；音频设备故障后恢复声音，macOS 音频输出回退；桌面设置损坏时无法启动；Jellyfin 请求与含日文名的 WebDAV 路径；以及大量来自应用内反馈的阅读、歌词、字幕、同步与制卡修复

### 注意事项

- **AnkiConnect 重排**：AnkiConnect 26.10.11.0 起拒绝写入卡片的 due 位置。Fushi 现在只通过 AnkiConnect 原生的 `scheduling.repositionNewCards` 按词频重排新卡；探测不到该接口时，手动与自动重排都会置灰并给出提示。这包括尚未带上该接口的现行 AnkiConnect 发布版，以及没有 `/api/v1` 的旧版 AnkiConnect，因此**经典 AnkiConnect 用户将失去词频重排**，直到升级到提供原生接口的版本。Fushi 复习内的重排不受影响
- 连不上 Anki 时暂存卡片改为开关，默认关闭
- 已移除：视频「跳过片头」按钮
- 闪退后下次启动会询问是否发送日志，自动发送默认关闭
- Galgame Hook 仍仅限 Windows；Linux 只提供外部 texthooker 文本页
- iOS 仍不包含在线扩展源、发现与通用下载中心
